description: A man in cream robes and a turban sits on a gilded throne-howdah atop a grey elephant with a red and gold cloth, passing under a massive red sandstone gateway with arched openings and domed pavilions. Armoured horsemen with long spears ride close on both sides of the elephant, and a crowd in turbans and dark robes stands around in a haze of dust. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.
